zh.title: 澳門航空 A321neo B-MBU 抵達桃園
zh.summary: 公開 ADS-B 觀測顯示，澳門航空（NX／AMU）註冊號 B-MBU 的 Airbus A321neo 於 8 月 9 日抵達桃園；澳門民航局登記資料列明其精確型號為 A321-271NX。
body: AVWIRE 公開 ADS-B 監測資料顯示，呼號 AMU615、註冊號 B-MBU 的 Airbus A321neo 於 2026 年 8 月 9 日抵達臺灣桃園國際機場（RCTP）。系統在 12:03:42Z 首次取得本次有效觀測，並於 13:08:18Z 依航機進入機場地理圍欄且高度欄位顯示為 ground，判定這次抵達已獲確認。這項判定只描述觀測到的抵達，不等同機場或航空公司的官方航班公告。
澳門特別行政區民航局公布的澳門註冊航空器名單，將 B-MBU 列在澳門航空股份有限公司名下，登記型號為 Airbus A321-271NX；ADS-B 使用的 A21N 則是 A321neo 系列的 ICAO 機型代碼。因此，這架航機並非營運者不明的 A321neo，而是可由註冊資料與 AMU 呼號交叉辨識的澳門航空機隊成員。澳門航空的 IATA 代碼為 NX，ICAO 代碼為 AMU。
航空公司背景方面，澳門民航局把澳門航空股份有限公司列為在澳門註冊成立的航空公司。這表示新聞應清楚交代其所屬地區為澳門，而非只列出 B-MBU 註冊號。本文採用官方公司名錄與航空器登記資料補足身分資訊，並保留 ADS-B 觀測作為本次抵達的主要時間與位置狀態依據。
臺灣航線背景方面，澳門民航局 2026 年 4 月 1 日更新的核准客運航班名單，列有澳門航空往返臺北、高雄及臺中的航線，其中臺中項目以星號標示為定期包機。主管機關同時註明，核准班次不等於航空公司實際執飛班次，實際頻率仍可能依商業決定調整；旅客查詢時仍應以澳門航空當期班表與機場航班資訊為準。
上述航線資料是澳門航空在臺服務的背景，不足以單獨證明 AMU615 當天由哪一座機場起飛，也不能只憑常態航網推定本次飛行的起點、任務性質或載客狀況。現有 ADS-B 來源能支持的核心事實，是 B-MBU 在指定時間抵達桃園；航線與公司資料則用來說明這架航機的營運者、所屬地區及該公司與臺灣市場的既有連結。
本次觀測主要採 Airplanes.live 公開社群 ADS-B 資料，系統另嘗試以 ADSB.lol 交叉確認，但當次第二來源狀態為 secondary_unavailable。航機身分另以澳門民航局的註冊航空器名單核對，公司與航線背景也分別引用該局航空企業資料及核准客運航班名單。這種分層取證方式可避免把即時觀測、航空器登記與航網背景混寫成未經來源支持的單一結論。

en.title: Air Macau A321neo B-MBU Arrives at Taiwan Taoyuan
en.summary: Public ADS-B observations show Air Macau Airbus A321neo B-MBU arrived at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport on August 9. Macao's civil aviation authority lists the aircraft as an Airbus A321-271NX operated by Air Macau.
body: AVWIRE's public ADS-B monitor recorded aircraft B-MBU, using callsign AMU615, arriving at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (RCTP) on August 9, 2026. The first valid observation for this event was at 12:03:42Z. The system confirmed the arrival at 13:08:18Z after the aircraft entered the airport geofence and its barometric-altitude field showed ground. This is an observation-based arrival determination, not an official flight announcement from the airport or airline.

The Civil Aviation Authority of Macao's list of Macao-registered aircraft identifies B-MBU as an Airbus A321-271NX under Air Macau Company Limited. The A21N code carried in the ADS-B observation is the ICAO aircraft-type code for the A321neo family. The registration record and the AMU callsign therefore provide specific operator context that was missing from the original article. Air Macau uses IATA designator NX and ICAO designator AMU.

The company context is also relevant. Macao's civil aviation authority lists Air Macau Company Limited among airlines incorporated in Macao. The aircraft should therefore be described as belonging to the Macao-based carrier, rather than as an unidentified A321neo defined only by its registration. The official company and aircraft-register pages supply identity context, while the ADS-B feeds remain the evidence for the timing and observed arrival state.

For Taiwan service context, the Macao authority's passenger-flight approvals updated on April 1, 2026 list Air Macau on Taipei, Kaohsiung and Taichung routes. The Taichung entry is marked as a regular charter route. The same official document warns that approved frequencies may differ from actual operations because airlines can adjust schedules for commercial reasons. Current booking and airport information should therefore be checked before travel.

That network background does not by itself establish the origin of AMU615 on this particular day. It also does not prove the flight's purpose, passenger load or operational assignment. The evidence supports a narrower conclusion: B-MBU arrived at Taoyuan at the stated time, the Macao register assigns the aircraft to Air Macau, and the carrier has approved Taiwan links in the cited regulatory list. These separate facts should not be collapsed into an unsupported route claim about the observed flight.

Airplanes.live supplied the primary public ADS-B observations. The monitor also attempted an ADSB.lol cross-check, but the secondary-source status for this event was secondary_unavailable. Aircraft identity was separately checked against the Macao aircraft register, while company and Taiwan-route background came from the authority's airline directory and approved passenger-flight list. Keeping those evidence layers distinct adds useful context without allowing a route database or model inference to overwrite what was actually observed.
